_README: Config for reward-guard.ps1 on CHEFFYPC. While the Reward Vault has NO active timer, any process under blockPaths (or named in blockProcessNames) is killed, unless spared by allowPaths/allowProcessNames. Any active reward timer (all 3 tiers) unlocks everything. Edit and re-run install-reward-guard.ps1, or restart the RewardGuard scheduled task, to apply.
_blockPaths_note: The Steam client (steam.exe) lives in the Steam root and is NOT listed here; only steamapps\common (the games) is. So Steam itself keeps running while its games are blocked.
_blockProcessNames_note: Other launchers/games to kill by name (matched without .exe), wherever they are installed. Steam is intentionally NOT here so it stays open. FFXIV + Dalamud's XIVLauncher are here because XIVLauncher installs under %LOCALAPPDATA% (outside the game folders).
_allowPaths_note: Folders spared even though they sit under a blockPath. Use this for non-game utilities (Wallpaper Engine, DisplayFusion, ...) and for productivity 'games' (Chill with You, On-Together). Listed under all three Steam libraries so it works wherever the game is installed.
allowPaths: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Chill with You Lo-Fi Story
